europe_now.title: Evacuations in Oleshky
europe_now.summary: Hundreds of residents were evacuated from the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky during a rare ceasefire in Ukraine. Humanitarian efforts remain limited as access to basic needs in the region continues to be severely constrained.

sources.headline: Residents leave Russian-occupied Oleshky in evacuation operation

europe_now.title: Judicial Dispute in Poland
europe_now.summary: Political tensions in Poland escalated significantly as police were deployed during a stand-off over control of the country's top court. Government-backed judges sought to oust the chief justice, deepening the institutional crisis.

sources.headline: Tusk-Nawrocki battle escalates as chief judge is ousted from Poland’s top court
Chaos at Poland’s constitutional court as government-backed judges seek to oust chief justice

top_stories.title: US Missile Supply to Ukraine
top_stories.summary: The United States has officially approved the sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine. This military support comes amid ongoing security developments in the region.

sources.headline: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine

top_stories.title: Russian Media Outlet Closure
top_stories.summary: The founder of a prominent Russian newspaper announced that the publication was forced to shut down under intense pressure from authorities. This closure marks another notable development in the Kremlin's ongoing crackdown on independent media.
